literature.headline_zh: 呼吸道合胞病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期呼吸道合胞病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: RSV-A分离株对多种mAbs的中和敏感性略低于RSV-B分离株。抗原图谱显示了抗体反应的亚型分离,RSV-A分离株聚类在一起,并与如MPE8和101F等抗体的中和能力较低相一致,而RSV-B分离株则形成一个与较高mAb敏感性相关的独特聚类。在兔疫苗接种模型中,RSV-A-only血清能够有效中和所有RSV-A分离株和RSV-B1参考株,但对当代RSV-B分离株的中和活性有所减弱。RSV-B-only血清在两种亚型之间表现出平衡的中和能力。RSV-A + RSV-B联合免疫产生了对所有分离株一致的强反应。 [10.1128/jvi.01221-26]

共纳入≥60岁住院病例97,712例,其中RSV特异性病例785例(0.8%),包括60-74岁338例,≥75岁447例。在RSV特异性病例中,≥75岁患者的累计住院时间中位数(四分位数范围)为10.00(6.00-22.00)天,与60-74岁各合并症亚组相当或较低,免疫抑制患者的住院时间最长(11.50 [7.00-26.00]天)。在合并症分层中,重症监护病房入院更为常见(13.85-22.34%),而≥75岁患者为5.03%。RSV特异性病例的总体病死率和RSV相关病死率在≥75岁患者中最高(总体病死率:19.3%;RSV相关病死率:10.3%)。 [10.1007/s40121-026-01447-9]

腺病毒PCR阳性检测到59例患者(19.5%),而RSV PCR阳性检测到58例患者(19.2%)。腺病毒快速检测试剂盒的灵敏度为98.31%,特异度为98.77%,阳性预测值为95.08%,阴性预测值为99.58%。RSV快速检测试剂盒表现出类似性能,灵敏度为98.28%,特异度为98.77%,阳性预测值为95.00%,阴性预测值为99.59%。两种病原体与PCR的一致性均非常好(κ = 0.958)。 [10.21203/rs.3.rs-10854073/v1]
在2019年至2023年间,共有67名参与者被随机分配,其中RSV/ΔNS2/Δ1313/I1314L、RSV/6120/ΔNS2/1030s和安慰剂组各20名,RSV/276组7名。 [10.1093/infdis/jiag489]
中位住院天数为6天,年龄≥75岁的患者住院天数显著更长。患有慢性神经系统疾病与住院天数增加有关。90天内再入院率为24%。 [10.3390/vaccines14100882]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: RSV-A isolates were slightly less susceptible to multiple mAbs than RSV-B isolates. [10.1128/jvi.01221-26]

A total of 97,712 hospitalized episodes in those aged ≥ 60 years were included in the analysis, of which 785 (0.8%) were RSV-specific cases (n = 338 aged 60-74 years, n = 447 aged ≥ 75 years). [10.1007/s40121-026-01447-9]

Adenovirus PCR positivity was detected in 59 patients (19.5%), while RSV PCR positivity was detected in 58 patients (19.2%). The adenovirus rapid test showed a sensitivity of 98.31%, a specificity of 98.77%, a positive predictive value of 95.08%, and a negative predictive value of 99.58%. [10.21203/rs.3.rs-10854073/v1]
Between years 2019 and 2023, 67 participants were randomized, including 20 each to RSV/ΔNS2/Δ1313/I1314L, RSV/6120/ΔNS2/1030s, and placebo arms and seven to the RSV/276 arm. [10.1093/infdis/jiag489]

The median length of stay was 6 days and was significantly longer in patients aged ≥75. Having a chronic neurological disease was associated with increased length of stay. The 90-day readmission rate was 24%. [10.3390/vaccines14100882]

在2019年至2023年间,共有67名参与者被随机分配,其中RSV/ΔNS2/Δ1313/I1314L、RSV/6120/ΔNS2/1030s和安慰剂组各20名,RSV/276组7名。 [10.1093/infdis/jiag489]。

RSV-A isolates were slightly less susceptible to multiple mAbs than RSV-B isolates. [10.1128/jvi.01221-26].
A total of 97,712 hospitalized episodes in those aged ≥ 60 years were included in the analysis, of which 785 (0.8%) were RSV-specific cases (n = 338 aged 60-74 years, n = 447 aged ≥ 75 years).

papers.title: Subtype-specific differences in susceptibility to monoclonal antibodies and vaccines among contemporary RSV-A and RSV-B isolates
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) continues to circulate at high levels despite the introduction of new monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) and vaccines targeting the pre-fusion F (pre-F) protein. We analyzed the viral genome sequences of 133 RSV clinical samples collected during the 2022–2023 and 2023–2024 seasons and selected representative isolates for phenotypic testing. We selected four RSV-A and four RSV-B replication-competent, sequence-verified stocks and then assessed them for replication kinetics in vitro and neutralization sensitivity with a panel of F-targeting mAbs and polyclonal sera using a rabbit vaccination model. Isolates retained sensitivity to all mAbs tested. We detected no mutations in mAb binding sites in the isolates tested. RSV-A isolates were slightly less susceptible to multiple mAbs than RSV-B isolates. Antigenic cartography revealed a separation of antibody responses by subtype: RSV-A isolates clustered together and aligned with lower neutralization by antibodies such as MPE8 and 101F, whereas RSV-B isolates formed a distinct cluster associated with higher mAb susceptibility. In a rabbit vaccination model, RSV-A-only sera efficiently neutralized all RSV-A isolates and the RSV-B1 reference strain but showed diminished activity against contemporary RSV-B isolates. RSV-B-only sera displayed balanced neutralization across both subtypes. Combined RSV-A + RSV-B immunization produced uniformly strong responses to all isolates, suggesting that multivalent exposure may overcome subtype-specific antibody polarization. Collectively, our results demonstrate consistent antigenic divergence of RSV subtypes and underscore the importance of using contemporary isolates, rather than legacy reference strains, to guide F-directed immunoprophylaxis and vaccine design. IMPORTANCE Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) remains a major cause of lower respiratory tract infections. Although new monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) and vaccines have been approved in recent years, the impact of circulating genetic diversity on these therapeutics is incompletely understood. In this study, we demonstrate how recent RSV isolates respond to a panel of mAbs and whether sera from rabbits vaccinated with mRNA vaccines effectively neutralize these isolates. We observe that RSV-A isolates are slightly more resistant to neutralization by mAbs than RSV-B isolates and that a bivalent vaccine elicits broader neutralizing responses than the monovalent vaccine. This study provides insights into how viral diversity may influence antibody-mediated protection and suggests that recent RSV-B isolates may respond differently from the laboratory-adapted strains commonly used in research, an important consideration for the design of next-generation vaccines and antibody therapeutics.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究分析了2022–2023和2023–2024季节收集的133份RSV临床样本,重点关注RSV-A和RSV-B分离株。使用兔疫苗接种模型对选定的分离株进行了表型测试,包括体外复制动力学和对F靶向单克隆抗体和多克隆血清的中和敏感性检测。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)尽管引入了新的单克隆抗体(mAbs)和疫苗,仍持续在高水平流行。我们分析了2022–2023和2023–2024季节收集的133份RSV临床样本的病毒基因组序列,并选择了代表性的分离株进行表型测试。我们选择了四种RSV-A和四种RSV-B具有复制能力且序列验证的株系,然后使用兔疫苗接种模型评估了它们的体外复制动力学和对F靶向单克隆抗体和多克隆血清的中和敏感性。所有测试的分离株均保留了对所有mAbs的敏感性。我们在测试的分离株中未检测到mAb结合位点的突变。RSV-A分离株对多种mAbs的中和敏感性略低于RSV-B分离株。抗原图谱显示了抗体反应的亚型分离:RSV-A分离株聚类在一起,并与如MPE8和101F等抗体的中和能力较低相一致,而RSV-B分离株则形成一个与较高mAb敏感性相关的独特聚类。在兔疫苗接种模型中,RSV-A-only血清能够有效中和所有RSV-A分离株和RSV-B1参考株,但对当代RSV-B分离株的中和活性有所减弱。RSV-B-only血清在两种亚型之间表现出平衡的中和能力。RSV-A + RSV-B联合免疫产生了对所有分离株一致的强反应,这表明多价暴露可能克服亚型特异性抗体极化。总体而言,我们的结果展示了RSV亚型之间一致的抗原差异,并强调了使用当代分离株而非传统参考株来指导F靶向免疫预防和疫苗设计的重要性。重要性 呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)仍然是下呼吸道感染的主要原因。尽管近年来批准了新的单克隆抗体(mAbs)和疫苗,但这些治疗药物对流行遗传多样性的影响仍不完全清楚。本研究探讨了近期RSV分离株对一组mAbs的反应情况,以及使用mRNA 疫苗免疫的兔血清是否能有效中和这些分离株。我们观察到RSV-A分离株对mAbs的中和能力略低于RSV-B分离株,并且双价疫苗比单价疫苗诱导更广泛的中和反应。本研究提供了关于病毒多样性如何影响抗体介导保护的见解,并表明近期RSV-B分离株可能与常用于研究的实验室适应株产生不同的反应,这对下一代疫苗和抗体治疗药物的设计具有重要意义。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在了解RSV的流行遗传多样性对针对RSV预融合F(pre-F)蛋白的单克隆抗体(mAbs)和疫苗疗效的影响。尽管引入了新的mAbs和疫苗,RSV-A和RSV-B亚型在治疗反应中的作用仍不清楚。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究分析了2022–2023和2023–2024季节收集的133份RSV临床样本,重点关注RSV-A和RSV-B分离株。使用兔疫苗接种模型对选定的分离株进行了表型测试,包括体外复制动力学和对F靶向单克隆抗体和多克隆血清的中和敏感性检测。
analysis_zh.methods: 分析病毒基因组序列以选择四种RSV-A和四种RSV-B具有复制能力且序列验证的株系。这些分离株使用兔疫苗接种模型进行体外复制动力学和中和敏感性测试。
analysis_zh.main_results: RSV-A分离株对多种mAbs的中和敏感性略低于RSV-B分离株。抗原图谱显示了抗体反应的亚型分离,RSV-A分离株聚类在一起,并与如MPE8和101F等抗体的中和能力较低相一致,而RSV-B分离株则形成一个与较高mAb敏感性相关的独特聚类。在兔疫苗接种模型中,RSV-A-only血清能够有效中和所有RSV-A分离株和RSV-B1参考株,但对当代RSV-B分离株的中和活性有所减弱。RSV-B-only血清在两种亚型之间表现出平衡的中和能力。RSV-A + RSV-B联合免疫产生了对所有分离株一致的强反应。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究展示了RSV亚型之间一致的抗原差异,并强调了使用当代分离株而非传统参考株来指导F靶向免疫预防和疫苗设计的重要性。这一发现表明,近期RSV-B分离株可能与常用于研究的实验室适应株产生不同的反应,这对下一代疫苗和抗体治疗药物的设计具有重要意义。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现提供了关于病毒多样性如何影响抗体介导保护的见解,并表明多价暴露可能克服亚型特异性抗体极化。这对设计能够有效针对RSV-A和RSV-B亚型的疫苗和抗体治疗药物具有重要意义。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于样本量较小以及依赖于体外模型。这些发现在真实世界环境中的适用性尚不确定。由于这些局限性,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Guillain-Barré syndrome temporally associated with respiratory syncytial virus vaccination
papers.abstract: An older woman developed acute progressive limb weakness associated with pain, paraesthesia and falls 2 weeks after receiving a respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) vaccine. Initial examination and imaging suggested alternative diagnoses, including cervical spondylotic disease and cerebrovascular pathology and early neurophysiology was non-diagnostic. During admission, she deteriorated with urinary retention, areflexia and type 2 respiratory failure requiring intubation and ventilation and was commenced on intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIG). Cerebrospinal fluid analysis later demonstrated albumin-cytologic dissociation and repeat nerve conduction studies confirmed an acute inflammatory demyelinating polyradiculoneuropathy consistent with Guillain-Barré syndrome (GBS). She improved following intensive care and IVIG, with partial recovery of limb strength and functional status and was discharged to a rehabilitation facility. This case illustrates a rare but important possible association between RSV vaccination and GBS; highlights the diagnostic challenges of early presentations with non-specific symptoms and inconclusive investigations; and emphasises the need for serial assessment and early escalation of care to optimise patient outcomes.

papers.title: SARS‐CoV‐2, Influenza Virus, and Respiratory Syncytial Virus Coinfections Among Symptomatic Outpatients in Lorestan Province, Iran: A Retrospective Cross‐Sectional Study
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Background and Aims Pathogenic viruses represent a principal etiology of acute respiratory tract disease. Concurrent detection of multiple respiratory pathogens has been associated with diagnostic challenges, therapeutic complications, and unfavorable outcomes in patients with COVID‐19. This investigation aimed to characterize the frequency of concurrent SARS‐CoV‐2, influenza virus, and human respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infections among individuals presenting with suspected COVID‐19 symptoms during the pandemic period in Lorestan Province, Iran. Methods A retrospective observational study was conducted among 196 participants who presented with suspected COVID‐19 and clinically compatible respiratory symptoms at regional healthcare facilities in Lorestan Province from July through December 2022. Nasopharyngeal specimens were obtained from all participants, maintained at 2°C–8°C during transit on ice, and subsequently subjected to nucleic acid extraction and multiplex quantitative reverse‐transcription polymerase chain reaction (qRT‐PCR) analysis at the Molecular Virology Laboratory. Results Of 196 participants evaluated, positivity rates were as follows: SARS‐CoV‐2, 40.81%; influenza virus, 30.10%; and RSV, 5.10%. Dual infections were identified in the following proportions: SARS‐CoV‐2 with RSV 3.57%, SARS‐CoV‐2 with influenza virus 11.22%, and RSV with influenza 3.06%. Simultaneous detection of all three pathogens was documented in 2.04% of the study population. Conclusion This study documents the circulation of SARS‐CoV‐2, influenza virus, and RSV among symptomatic outpatients in Lorestan Province during the study period, including a limited number of dual and triple coinfections. These findings highlight the importance of continued respiratory virus surveillance and multiplex molecular testing in outpatient settings. Nevertheless, the small numbers of RSV‐positive patients, triple‐infection cases, and children younger than 6 years limit the strength of subgroup‐based inferences; therefore, age‐specific, pediatric, and symptom‐related findings should be interpreted cautiously. Further studies with larger and more diverse populations are warranted.

A retrospective observational study was conducted on 196 participants, with nasopharyngeal specimens analyzed using multiplex quantitative reverse‐transcription polymerase chain reaction (qRT‐PCR). The results showed that SARS‐CoV‐2 had the highest positivity rate at 40.81%, followed by influenza virus at 30.10% and RSV at 5.10%. Dual infections were observed in 3.57% (RSV and SARS‐CoV‐2), 11.22% (SARS‐CoV‐2 and influenza), and 3.06% (RSV and influenza) of the study population, with triple coinfections documented in 2.04%. The authors concluded that these findings emphasize the need for continued respiratory virus surveillance and multiplex molecular testing in outpatient settings. However, the limited number of RSV-positive patients and triple infections, as well as the small sample of children under 6 years, restrict the strength of subgroup-based conclusions.

papers.title_zh: 伊朗洛雷斯坦省新冠状病毒SARS‐CoV‐2、流感病毒和人类呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)在有症状门诊患者中的共感染:回顾性横断面研究
papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT Background and Aims Pathogenic viruses represent a principal etiology of acute respiratory tract disease. Concurrent detection of multiple respiratory pathogens has been associated with diagnostic challenges, therapeutic complications, and unfavorable outcomes in patients with COVID‐19. This investigation aimed to characterize the frequency of concurrent SARS‐CoV‐2, influenza virus, and human respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infections among individuals presenting with suspected COVID‐19 symptoms during the pandemic period in Lorestan Province, Iran. Methods A retrospective observational study was conducted among 196 participants who presented with suspected COVID‐19 and clinically compatible respiratory symptoms at regional healthcare facilities in Lorestan Province from July through December 2022. Nasopharyngeal specimens were obtained from all participants, maintained at 2°C–8°C during transit on ice, and subsequently subjected to nucleic acid extraction and multiplex quantitative reverse‐transcription polymerase chain reaction (qRT‐PCR) analysis at the Molecular Virology Laboratory. Results Of 196 participants evaluated, positivity rates were as follows: SARS‐CoV‐2, 40.81%; influenza virus, 30.10%; and RSV, 5.10%. Dual infections were identified in the following proportions: SARS‐CoV‐2 with RSV 3.57%, SARS‐CoV‐2 with influenza virus 11.22%, and RSV with influenza 3.06%. Simultaneous detection of all three pathogens was documented in 2.04% of the study population. Conclusion This study documents the circulation of SARS‐CoV‐2, influenza virus, and RSV among symptomatic outpatients in Lorestan Province during the study period, including a limited number of dual and triple coinfections. These findings highlight the importance of continued respiratory virus surveillance and multiplex molecular testing in outpatient settings. Nevertheless, the small numbers of RSV‐positive patients, triple‐infection cases, and children younger than 6 years limit the strength of subgroup‐based inferences; therefore, age‐specific, pediatric, and symptom‐related findings should be interpreted cautiously. Further studies with larger and more diverse populations are warranted.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景与目的 致病性病毒是急性呼吸道疾病的主要病因。在新冠状病毒(COVID-19)患者中,同时检测到多种呼吸道病原体与诊断困难、治疗并发症和不良预后有关。本研究旨在描述在伊朗洛雷斯坦省疫情期间,出现疑似新冠状病毒症状的个体中,同时感染SARS-CoV-2、流感病毒和人类呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)的频率。方法 本研究是一项回顾性观察性研究,共纳入196名在2022年7月至12月期间因疑似新冠状病毒和临床相符的呼吸道症状前往地区医疗机构就诊的参与者。所有参与者均采集鼻咽拭子样本,样本在冰上运输并在2°C–8°C条件下保存,随后在分子病毒学实验室进行核酸提取和多重定量逆转录聚合酶链反应(qRT-PCR)分析。结果 在评估的196名参与者中,阳性率分别为:SARS-CoV-2 40.81%;流感病毒 30.10%;RSV 5.10%。双重感染的比例为:SARS-CoV-2与RSV 3.57%;SARS-CoV-2与流感病毒 11.22%;RSV与流感病毒 3.06%。同时检测到三种病原体的病例占研究人群的2.04%。结论 本研究记录了在洛雷斯坦省疫情期间,SARS-CoV-2、流感病毒和RSV在有症状的门诊患者中的流行情况,包括少数的双重和三重感染病例。这些发现强调了在门诊环境中持续进行呼吸道病毒监测和多重分子检测的重要性。然而,RSV阳性患者数量较少、三重感染病例以及6岁以下儿童的数量有限,限制了基于亚组的推论力度;因此,应谨慎解释与年龄、儿科和症状相关的发现。需要进一步进行更大规模和更多样化人群的研究。

papers.title: Clinical and economic benefits of bivalent respiratory syncytial virus prefusion F (RSVpreF) vaccine for prevention of RSV in adults: a cost-effectiveness analysis for Singapore
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is a common virus causing severe illness in adults. RSV prefusion F protein subunit (RSVpreF) vaccine was approved by the Singapore Health Sciences Authority for adults aged 18-59 years at increased risk and for adults aged ≥ 60 years, to prevent RSV-associated lower respiratory tract disease. This study estimated the clinical and economic impact of RSVpreF vaccination for the prevention of RSV among adults in Singapore. RESEARCH DESIGN AND METHODS: A Markov model projected clinical and economic outcomes of RSV for the vaccination of adults with RSVpreF compared to no intervention. Analyses were conducted from the healthcare system perspective, with direct costs (2025 Singapore dollars [S$]) and outcomes discounted at 3% annually; scenario/sensitivity analyses tested model robustness. RESULTS: Compared to no intervention, RSVpreF vaccination would prevent 4,675 hospitalizations, 14,064 emergency department cases, and 37,631 outpatient visits over lifetime, averting S$31.92 million in direct medical costs with a gain of 2,675 quality-adjusted life years (QALYs). The RSVpreF vaccine would be cost-effective up to S$440.79/dose under a threshold of 1 × gross domestic product per capita per QALY gained (S$122,370). CONCLUSIONS: RSVpreF vaccination would substantially reduce the clinical and economic burden of RSV among adults in Singapore.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is a common virus causing severe illness in adults. This study aimed to evaluate the clinical and economic benefits of a bivalent RSVpreF vaccine for preventing RSV in adults.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A cost-effectiveness analysis was conducted for the RSVpreF vaccine in Singapore, focusing on adults aged 18-59 years at increased risk and adults aged ≥ 60 years. The study projected clinical and economic outcomes over a lifetime.
analysis.methods: A Markov model was used to project clinical and economic outcomes of RSV for the vaccination of adults with RSVpreF compared to no intervention. Analyses were conducted from the healthcare system perspective, with direct costs (2025 Singapore dollars [S$]) and outcomes discounted at 3% annually; scenario/sensitivity analyses tested model robustness.
analysis.main_results: RSVpreF vaccination would prevent 4,675 hospitalizations, 14,064 emergency department cases, and 37,631 outpatient visits over lifetime, averting S$31.92 million in direct medical costs with a gain of 2,675 quality-adjusted life years (QALYs).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that the RSVpreF vaccine would be cost-effective up to S$440.79/dose under a threshold of 1 × gross domestic product per capita per QALY gained (S$122,370).
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that RSVpreF vaccination could substantially reduce the clinical and economic burden of RSV among adults in Singapore, providing important insights for public health decision-making.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on a Markov model, which may introduce assumptions and uncertainties. The evidence is considered moderate due to the reliance on projected outcomes and sensitivity analyses.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluates the clinical and economic benefits of the RSVpreF vaccine for preventing RSV in adults in Singapore. The research uses a Markov model to project outcomes over a lifetime, estimating that the vaccine would prevent thousands of hospitalizations, emergency department visits, and outpatient cases while averting significant medical costs. The vaccine is found to be cost-effective up to a certain dose threshold, which could inform public health strategies. However, the study's reliance on modeling introduces assumptions and uncertainties, limiting the confidence in the findings. The results highlight the potential impact of RSVpreF vaccination on reducing the burden of RSV in the adult population.

papers.title_zh: 二价呼吸道合胞病毒前融合F蛋白(RSVpreF)疫苗在预防成人呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)感染中的临床和经济效益:新加坡的成本效益分析
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is a common virus causing severe illness in adults. RSV prefusion F protein subunit (RSVpreF) vaccine was approved by the Singapore Health Sciences Authority for adults aged 18-59 years at increased risk and for adults aged ≥ 60 years, to prevent RSV-associated lower respiratory tract disease. This study estimated the clinical and economic impact of RSVpreF vaccination for the prevention of RSV among adults in Singapore. RESEARCH DESIGN AND METHODS: A Markov model projected clinical and economic outcomes of RSV for the vaccination of adults with RSVpreF compared to no intervention. Analyses were conducted from the healthcare system perspective, with direct costs (2025 Singapore dollars [S$]) and outcomes discounted at 3% annually; scenario/sensitivity analyses tested model robustness. RESULTS: Compared to no intervention, RSVpreF vaccination would prevent 4,675 hospitalizations, 14,064 emergency department cases, and 37,631 outpatient visits over lifetime, averting S$31.92 million in direct medical costs with a gain of 2,675 quality-adjusted life years (QALYs). The RSVpreF vaccine would be cost-effective up to S$440.79/dose under a threshold of 1 × gross domestic product per capita per QALY gained (S$122,370). CONCLUSIONS: RSVpreF vaccination would substantially reduce the clinical and economic burden of RSV among adults in Singapore.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)是一种在成人中引起严重疾病的常见病毒。RSV prefusion F蛋白亚单位(RSVpreF) 疫苗 已经获得新加坡卫生科学局批准,用于预防与RSV相关的下呼吸道疾病,适用于18-59岁有较高风险的成人以及≥60岁的成人。本研究评估了RSVpreF 疫苗接种 在预防RSV方面对新加坡成人临床和经济影响。研究设计与方法:采用马尔可夫模型预测RSVpreF 疫苗接种 与无干预相比,对成人RSV的临床和经济结果。分析从卫生系统角度进行,直接成本以2025年新加坡元(S$)计算,临床和经济结果均按每年3%的折现率进行折现;情景/敏感性分析用于测试模型的稳健性。结果:与无干预相比,RSVpreF 疫苗接种 在终身范围内可预防4,675例住院、14,064例急诊科就诊和37,631例门诊就诊,避免直接医疗费用达S$31.92百万,并获得2,675个质量调整生命年(QALYs)。在每获得1个QALY的阈值为S$122,370的情况下,RSVpreF 疫苗 的成本效益可达每剂量S$440.79。结论:RSVpreF 疫苗接种 将显著降低新加坡成人中RSV的临床和经济负担。

papers.title: Clinical Burden of Disease and Demographics in Older Adults Hospitalized with RSV Infection in England: A Retrospective Cohort Study
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) causes significant disease in older and comorbid adults. Current UK vaccination recommendations restrict eligibility to adults ≥ 75 years, 65-74 years with chronic respiratory disease or immunosuppression, and those in care homes, but evidence on clinical burden in adults < 75 years with comorbidities is limited. This study assessed patient characteristics, healthcare resource utilization (HCRU), and mortality in adults hospitalized with RSV in England. METHODS: Population-based retrospective cohort study using linked Clinical Practice Research Datalink Aurum and Hospital Episode Statistics. Adults ≥ 60 years hospitalized with RSV between October 2014 and March 2019 were included. We defined RSV episodes as 90 days post-diagnosis. We defined cases using diagnosis codes for confirmed RSV (RSV-specific) or acute lower respiratory tract infection with exclusion of other causative pathogens (RSV-possible). All-cause HCRU (hospitalizations, critical care admissions, outpatient attendance, primary care consultations, and prescriptions) and case fatality rates were assessed. Results were stratified by age (60-74 and ≥ 75 years), case definitions (RSV-specific, RSV-possible), and comorbidity profiles (chronic respiratory disease, immunocompromised, cardiovascular disease). RESULTS: A total of 97,712 hospitalized episodes in those aged ≥ 60 years were included in the analysis, of which 785 (0.8%) were RSV-specific cases (n = 338 aged 60-74 years, n = 447 aged ≥ 75 years). In RSV-specific cases, median (IQR) cumulative length of stay (LoS) for those ≥ 75 years was 10.00 (6.00-22.00) days, which was equivalent to or lower than each comorbidity subgroup in those aged 60-74 years, with the longest LoS in those immunocompromised (11.50 [7.00-26.00] days). Critical care admissions were more often observed across comorbidity stratifications (13.85-22.34%) compared to those ≥ 75 years (5.03%). All-cause and RSV-related case fatality rates for RSV-specific cases were highest among those ≥ 75 years (all-cause: 19.3%; RSV-related: 10.3%). CONCLUSIONS: HCRU within RSV episodes in those aged 60-74 years across comorbidity profiles was equal to or greater than that in those aged ≥ 75 years. These findings highlight the need to prioritize consideration of comorbidity groups that could benefit from RSV vaccination.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)在老年人和合并症成人中引起显著疾病。当前英国的疫苗接种建议将符合条件的成人限制为≥75岁、65-74岁伴有慢性呼吸系统疾病或免疫抑制以及居住在护理院的成人,但对于<75岁伴有合并症的成人临床负担的证据有限。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究评估了在英格兰因RSV住院的成人患者的特征、卫生资源利用(HCRU)和死亡率。2014年10月至2019年3月间因RSV住院的≥60岁成人被纳入研究。
elements_zh.methods: 基于人群的回顾性队列研究研究,使用Clinical Practice Research Datalink Aurum和Hospital Episode Statistics进行链接。评估了所有原因的HCRU(住院、重症监护病房入院、门诊就诊、初级保健咨询和处方)和病死率。
elements_zh.main_results: 共纳入≥60岁住院病例97,712例,其中RSV特异性病例785例(0.8%),包括60-74岁338例,≥75岁447例。在RSV特异性病例中,≥75岁患者的累计住院时间中位数(四分位数范围)为10.00(6.00-22.00)天,与60-74岁各合并症亚组相当或较低,免疫抑制患者的住院时间最长(11.50 [7.00-26.00]天)。在合并症分层中,重症监护病房入院更为常见(13.85-22.34%),而≥75岁患者为5.03%。RSV特异性病例的总体病死率和RSV相关病死率在≥75岁患者中最高(总体病死率:19.3%;RSV相关病死率:10.3%)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在60-74岁伴有不同合并症的RSV发作期内,卫生资源利用与≥75岁患者相当或更高。这些发现强调了需要优先考虑可能从RSV 疫苗接种中受益的合并症组别。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果为了解老年人伴有合并症的RSV临床负担提供了关键见解,有助于制定针对性的疫苗接种策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究为回顾性队列研究研究,可能存在偏倚和混杂因素。证据强度为中等,由于研究的观察性质和数据链接及完整性的潜在限制。

papers.abstract_zh: 引言:呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)在老年和患有合并症的成年人中会引起显著的疾病。目前英国的RSV疫苗接种建议仅限于年龄≥75岁的成年人、65-74岁且患有慢性呼吸道疾病或免疫抑制的成年人,以及居住在护理机构的人群,但对于年龄小于75岁且有合并症的成年人的临床负担证据有限。本研究评估了在英格兰因RSV住院的成年人的患者特征、卫生保健资源利用(HCRU)和死亡率。方法:本研究为基于人群的回顾性队列研究,利用临床实践研究数据链接数据库Aurum和医院事件统计数据库。纳入了2014年10月至2019年3月期间年龄≥60岁且因RSV住院的成年人。我们将RSV发作定义为RSV感染后90天内。使用RSV特异性诊断代码或排除其他病原体的急性下呼吸道感染诊断代码(RSV-possible)来定义病例。评估了全因HCRU(住院、重症监护入院、门诊就诊、初级保健咨询和处方)和病例死亡率。结果按年龄(60-74岁和≥75岁)、病例定义(RSV特异性、RSV-possible)和合并症状况(慢性呼吸道疾病、免疫抑制、心血管疾病)进行分层。结果:分析共纳入了97,712例年龄≥60岁住院的病例,其中785例(0.8%)为RSV特异性病例(60-74岁患者338例,≥75岁患者447例)。在RSV特异性病例中,年龄≥75岁的患者中位数(四分位数范围)累计住院天数(LoS)为10.00(6.00-22.00)天,这相当于或低于60-74岁患者的各合并症亚组,其中免疫抑制患者住院天数最长(11.50 [7.00-26.00] 天)。在合并症分层中,重症监护入院的发生率(13.85-22.34%)高于年龄≥75岁患者(5.03%)。RSV特异性病例的全因和RSV相关病例死亡率在年龄≥75岁患者中最高(全因:19.3%;RSV相关:10.3%)。结论:在年龄60-74岁且有合并症的患者中,RSV发作期间的HCRU等于或高于年龄≥75岁的患者。这些发现强调了需要优先考虑可能从RSV疫苗接种中受益的合并症群体。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)在老年人和合并症成人中引起显著疾病。当前英国的疫苗接种建议将符合条件的成人限制为≥75岁、65-74岁伴有慢性呼吸系统疾病或免疫抑制以及居住在护理院的成人,但对于<75岁伴有合并症的成人临床负担的证据有限。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究评估了在英格兰因RSV住院的成人患者的特征、卫生资源利用(HCRU)和死亡率。2014年10月至2019年3月间因RSV住院的≥60岁成人被纳入研究。
analysis_zh.methods: 基于人群的回顾性队列研究研究,使用Clinical Practice Research Datalink Aurum和Hospital Episode Statistics进行链接。评估了所有原因的HCRU(住院、重症监护病房入院、门诊就诊、初级保健咨询和处方)和病死率。
analysis_zh.main_results: 共纳入≥60岁住院病例97,712例,其中RSV特异性病例785例(0.8%),包括60-74岁338例,≥75岁447例。在RSV特异性病例中,≥75岁患者的累计住院时间中位数(四分位数范围)为10.00(6.00-22.00)天,与60-74岁各合并症亚组相当或较低,免疫抑制患者的住院时间最长(11.50 [7.00-26.00]天)。在合并症分层中,重症监护病房入院更为常见(13.85-22.34%),而≥75岁患者为5.03%。RSV特异性病例的总体病死率和RSV相关病死率在≥75岁患者中最高(总体病死率:19.3%;RSV相关病死率:10.3%)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在60-74岁伴有不同合并症的RSV发作期内,卫生资源利用与≥75岁患者相当或更高。这些发现强调了需要优先考虑可能从RSV 疫苗接种中受益的合并症组别。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果为了解老年人伴有合并症的RSV临床负担提供了关键见解,有助于制定针对性的疫苗接种策略。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究为回顾性队列研究研究,可能存在偏倚和混杂因素。证据强度为中等,由于研究的观察性质和数据链接及完整性的潜在限制。

papers.title: Evaluation of Three Recombinant Live-Attenuated Respiratory Syncytial Virus Vaccines RSV/ΔNS2/Δ1313/I1314L, RSV/6120/ΔNS2/1030s, and RSV/276 in RSV Seronegative Children
papers.abstract: Abstract Background An effective RSV vaccine which elicits active immunity and lasting protection could have a significant impact on child health. This study evaluated safety and immunogenicity of three intranasal live-attenuated candidate RSV vaccines, RSV/ΔNS2/Δ1313/I1314L, RSV/6120/ΔNS2/1030s, and RSV/276 to placebo. Methods Healthy, RSV-seronegative children 6-24 months of age were randomized to receive one of three candidate vaccines or placebo in a blinded manner. Participants were monitored for vaccine reactogenicity and RSV serum antibodies and over the subsequent RSV season. Results Between years 2019 and 2023, 67 participants were randomized, including 20 each to RSV/ΔNS2/Δ1313/I1314L, RSV/6120/ΔNS2/1030s, and placebo arms and seven to the RSV/276 arm. The RSV/276 arm was closed early due to an excess of mild cough events in another study. The proportion (95% confidence interval) of children who experienced at least one solicited an adverse event during the 28 days after inoculation was 55% (32%, 77%) in the RSV/ΔNS2/Δ1313/I1314L arm, 40% (19%, 64%) in the RSV/6120/ΔNS2/1030s arm, 71% (29%, 96%) in the RSV/276 arm, and 55% (32%, 77%) in the placebo arm. Events were mostly Grade 1 and were often associated with other viruses. The proportion of children with a ≥4-fold increase in serum RSV-neutralizing antibody titer in each of the candidate vaccine arms (>70%) was significantly greater than in the placebo arm (15%). Conclusions RSV/ΔNS2/Δ1313/I1314L and RSV/6120/ΔNS2/1030s had excellent safety and immunogenicity; the assessment of RSV/276 was limited by the small sample size. RSV/ΔNS2/Δ1313/I1314L and RSV/6120/ΔNS2/1030s were deemed suitable for further evaluation.
authors: International Maternal Pediatric Adolescent AIDS Clinical Trials (IMPAACT) 2021 Study Team

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the safety and immunogenicity of three intranasal live-attenuated RSV vaccines in RSV-seronegative children. The research aimed to identify vaccines that could provide active immunity and lasting protection against RSV, which is a significant cause of respiratory illness in children. The study involved 67 participants randomized into three vaccine arms and one placebo arm, with the RSV/276 arm closed early due to safety concerns. The results showed that the proportion of children with a ≥4-fold increase in serum RSV-neutralizing antibody titer was significantly higher in the vaccine arms compared to the placebo group. The vaccines RSV/ΔNS2/Δ1313/I1314L and RSV/6120/ΔNS2/1030s demonstrated excellent safety and immunogenicity, making them suitable for further evaluation. However, the small sample size in the RSV/276 arm limited its assessment. The findings suggest that these vaccines could be promising candidates for future development, potentially improving child health by reducing RSV-related illnesses.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 一种能够激发主动免疫并提供持久保护的有效的呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)疫苗可能对儿童健康产生重大影响。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究评估了三种鼻内减毒候选RSV疫苗RSV/ΔNS2/Δ1313/I1314L、RSV/6120/ΔNS2/1030s和RSV/276与安慰剂的安全性和免疫原性。
elements_zh.methods: 健康、RSV血清阴性的6至24个月龄儿童被随机分配接受三种候选RSV疫苗中的一种或安慰剂,并在盲法下进行。参与者在随后的RSV季节中被监测其疫苗反应性和RSV血清抗体。
elements_zh.main_results: 在2019年至2023年间,共有67名参与者被随机分配,其中RSV/ΔNS2/Δ1313/I1314L、RSV/6120/ΔNS2/1030s和安慰剂组各20名,RSV/276组7名。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在每个候选RSV疫苗组中,血清RSV中和抗体滴度≥4倍增加的儿童比例(>70%)显著高于安慰剂组(15%)。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: RSV/ΔNS2/Δ1313/I1314L和RSV/6120/ΔNS2/1030s被认为适合进一步评估。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于另一项研究中出现过多轻度咳嗽事件,RSV/276组提前关闭。

papers.title: Diagnostic Accuracy of the RapidForTM RSV/ADV Rapid Test Kit Compared with PCR for the Detection of Respiratory Syncytial Virus and Adenovirus in Nasopharyngeal Swab Samples
papers.abstract: Abstract Background: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) and adenovirus are important causes of acute respiratory tract infections in children, but their clinical presentations often overlap with those of other viral and bacterial pathogens. Although the polymerase chain reaction (PCR) is the reference standard for diagnosis, rapid antigen tests may provide clinically useful results in emergency settings. This study evaluated the diagnostic accuracy of the RapidForTM RSV/ADV Rapid Test Kit compared with multiplex PCR in pediatric patients with acute respiratory symptoms. Methods: This prospective diagnostic accuracy study included 302 children aged ≤ 18 years who presented to a pediatric emergency department with acute respiratory symptoms from February to May 2025. Two nasopharyngeal swabs were obtained from each participant. The RapidForTM RSV/ADV Rapid Test Kit was performed immediately at the point of care, and multiplex real-time PCR served as the reference standard. Sensitivity, specificity, positive and negative predictive values, and Cohen’s kappa agreement were calculated. Diagnostic performance was also assessed by age group, and multivariable logistic regression was used to identify independent predictors of PCR-confirmed positivity for adenovirus and RSV. Results: Adenovirus PCR positivity was detected in 59 patients (19.5%), while RSV PCR positivity was detected in 58 patients (19.2%). The adenovirus rapid test showed a sensitivity of 98.31%, a specificity of 98.77%, a positive predictive value of 95.08%, and a negative predictive value of 99.58%. The RSV rapid test demonstrated similar performance, with a sensitivity of 98.28%, a specificity of 98.77%, a positive predictive value of 95.00%, and a negative predictive value of 99.59%. Agreement with PCR was excellent for both pathogens (κ = 0.958). RSV positivity was highest among infants younger than one year, whereas adenovirus positivity peaked in school-aged children. Conjunctival injection and fever were independent predictors of adenovirus positivity, while cough and age under one year independently predicted RSV positivity. Conclusions: The RapidForTM RSV/ADV Rapid Test Kit demonstrated high diagnostic accuracy and excellent agreement with multiplex PCR for detecting adenovirus and RSV in children presenting to the emergency department. Its rapid turnaround and ability to detect both pathogens from a single sample may support timely clinical decision-making in pediatric acute care settings.

papers.title_zh: 快速诊断试剂盒RapidForTM RSV/ADV快速检测试剂盒与PCR在鼻咽拭子样本中检测呼吸道合胞病毒和腺病毒的诊断准确性比较
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Background: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) and adenovirus are important causes of acute respiratory tract infections in children, but their clinical presentations often overlap with those of other viral and bacterial pathogens. Although the polymerase chain reaction (PCR) is the reference standard for diagnosis, rapid antigen tests may provide clinically useful results in emergency settings. This study evaluated the diagnostic accuracy of the RapidForTM RSV/ADV Rapid Test Kit compared with multiplex PCR in pediatric patients with acute respiratory symptoms. Methods: This prospective diagnostic accuracy study included 302 children aged ≤ 18 years who presented to a pediatric emergency department with acute respiratory symptoms from February to May 2025. Two nasopharyngeal swabs were obtained from each participant. The RapidForTM RSV/ADV Rapid Test Kit was performed immediately at the point of care, and multiplex real-time PCR served as the reference standard. Sensitivity, specificity, positive and negative predictive values, and Cohen’s kappa agreement were calculated. Diagnostic performance was also assessed by age group, and multivariable logistic regression was used to identify independent predictors of PCR-confirmed positivity for adenovirus and RSV. Results: Adenovirus PCR positivity was detected in 59 patients (19.5%), while RSV PCR positivity was detected in 58 patients (19.2%). The adenovirus rapid test showed a sensitivity of 98.31%, a specificity of 98.77%, a positive predictive value of 95.08%, and a negative predictive value of 99.58%. The RSV rapid test demonstrated similar performance, with a sensitivity of 98.28%, a specificity of 98.77%, a positive predictive value of 95.00%, and a negative predictive value of 99.59%. Agreement with PCR was excellent for both pathogens (κ = 0.958). RSV positivity was highest among infants younger than one year, whereas adenovirus positivity peaked in school-aged children. Conjunctival injection and fever were independent predictors of adenovirus positivity, while cough and age under one year independently predicted RSV positivity. Conclusions: The RapidForTM RSV/ADV Rapid Test Kit demonstrated high diagnostic accuracy and excellent agreement with multiplex PCR for detecting adenovirus and RSV in children presenting to the emergency department. Its rapid turnaround and ability to detect both pathogens from a single sample may support timely clinical decision-making in pediatric acute care settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景:呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)和腺病毒是儿童急性呼吸道感染的重要病原体,但其临床表现常与其他病毒和细菌病原体重叠。尽管聚合酶链反应(PCR)是呼吸道合胞病毒的参考标准,但在紧急情况下,快速抗原检测可能提供具有临床意义的结果。本研究评估了快速诊断试剂盒RapidForTM RSV/ADV快速检测试剂盒与多重PCR在儿科急性呼吸道症状患者中的诊断准确性。方法:本项前瞻性诊断准确性研究纳入了2025年2月至5月期间因急性呼吸道症状就诊于儿科急诊科的302名年龄≤18岁的儿童。每位参与者均采集了2份鼻咽拭子样本。快速诊断试剂盒RapidForTM RSV/ADV快速检测试剂盒在床边立即进行检测,多重实时PCR作为参考标准。计算了灵敏度、特异度、阳性预测值和阴性预测值,以及Cohen’s kappa一致性。还按年龄组评估了诊断性能,并使用多变量逻辑回归分析确定了腺病毒和RSV PCR确认阳性结果的独立预测因素。结果:腺病毒PCR阳性检测到59例患者(19.5%),而RSV PCR阳性检测到58例患者(19.2%)。腺病毒快速检测试剂盒的灵敏度为98.31%,特异度为98.77%,阳性预测值为95.08%,阴性预测值为99.58%。RSV快速检测试剂盒表现出类似性能,灵敏度为98.28%,特异度为98.77%,阳性预测值为95.00%,阴性预测值为99.59%。两种病原体与PCR的一致性均非常好(κ = 0.958)。RSV阳性在1岁以下婴儿中最高,而腺病毒阳性在学龄儿童中达到峰值。结膜充血和发热是腺病毒阳性的独立预测因素,而咳嗽和年龄小于1岁是RSV阳性的独立预测因素。结论:快速诊断试剂盒RapidForTM RSV/ADV快速检测试剂盒在检测急诊科就诊儿童中的腺病毒和RSV时表现出高诊断准确性和与多重PCR的良好一致性。其快速的检测速度和从单个样本中同时检测两种病原体的能力可能有助于儿科急性护理环境中的及时临床决策。

papers.title: Nosocomial Respiratory Syncytial Virus in the Post-Pandemic Era: Evolving Epidemiology and Integrated Prevention Strategies
papers.abstract: Background/Objectives: Pandemic non-pharmaceutical interventions virtually eliminated respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) circulation in 2020–2021, and their relaxation was followed by unprecedented off-season resurgences. This narrative review, informed by a structured literature search, synthesizes current evidence on healthcare-associated RSV (HA-RSV), including transmission dynamics, vulnerable inpatient populations, and integrated prevention strategies, in the post-pandemic era. Methods: We searched PubMed/MEDLINE and Europe PMC (January 2000–October 2025) using two complementary strategies, supplemented by WHO and CDC guidance. Primary hospital-based studies reporting laboratory-confirmed HA-RSV cases formed the core evidence set; surveillance reports, systematic reviews, and guidance were used as labeled contextual evidence and synthesized narratively. Results: Twenty-nine primary studies from neonatal, pediatric, adult, geriatric, and immunocompromised settings provided direct evidence on HA-RSV, which accounted for 3–15% of RSV hospitalizations depending on setting and case definition and was associated with prolonged stay, escalation of respiratory support, higher costs, and, in children, higher mortality than community-onset infection. Universal masking and pre-admission screening were followed by reductions in HA-RSV in most before–after studies. Post-pandemic surveillance shows earlier, less predictable RSV activity and periods of concurrent circulation with influenza and SARS-CoV-2. RSV spreads mainly through short-range respiratory particles and contaminated hands and surfaces; asymptomatic or mildly symptomatic healthcare workers are one potential source of introduction. Conclusions: Prevention of HA-RSV rests on hand hygiene, transmission-based precautions, environmental disinfection, rapid molecular diagnostics, and supportive healthcare-worker and visitor policies, escalated according to local surveillance rather than the calendar. Immunoprophylaxis and vaccination reduce severe RSV disease in eligible groups, but direct evidence that they prevent healthcare-associated transmission is lacking.

analysis.summary_en: This review examines the evolving epidemiology and prevention strategies for healthcare-associated respiratory syncytial virus (HA-RSV) in the post-pandemic era. It highlights that HA-RSV accounts for 3–15% of RSV hospitalizations and is linked to prolonged stays, higher costs, and increased mortality in children. Universal masking and pre-admission screening have shown reductions in HA-RSV in most before–after studies. Prevention strategies include hand hygiene, transmission-based precautions, environmental disinfection, and supportive policies for healthcare workers and visitors, tailored to local surveillance. However, direct evidence on the effectiveness of immunoprophylaxis and vaccination in preventing HA-RSV transmission is lacking. The review underscores the need for adaptive strategies and further research to address the unpredictable nature of HA-RSV, which now circulates earlier and concurrently with influenza and SARS-CoV-2.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述聚焦于后疫情时代医院相关呼吸道合胞病毒(HA-RSV)的传播,探讨其传播模式、传播动态、易感住院人群以及综合预防策略。核心问题是HA-RSV如何演变,以及在医疗环境中哪些预防措施有效。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本综述基于结构化的文献检索,检索了PubMed/MEDLINE和欧洲PMC(2000年1月至2025年10月)的资料,并补充了世界卫生组织(WHO)和美国疾病控制与预防中心(CDC)的指导文件。主要证据集包括报告实验室确诊HA-RSV病例的医院研究,而RSV暴发报告、系统综述和指导文件则作为背景证据,以叙述性方式综合。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: HA-RSV在不同环境和病例定义下占RSV住院病例的3–15%,与住院时间延长、呼吸支持升级、费用增加以及儿童中比社区获得性感染更高的死亡率相关。在大多数前后对照研究中,普遍佩戴口罩和入院前筛查均导致HA-RSV病例减少。预防策略包括手卫生、基于传播模式的预防措施、环境消毒、快速分子诊断以及支持医护人员和访客的政策,这些措施应根据当地RSV暴发情况而非日历进行调整。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 目前缺乏直接证据表明免疫预防和尼塞韦单抗能预防医院相关的RSV传播。综述还指出,后疫情时代的RSV暴发显示出更早且更不可预测的活动模式,并与流感和SARS-CoV-2同时传播。这些发现突显了对HA-RSV传播模式和动态变化理解的不足。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 未来的研究应优先获取免疫预防和尼塞韦单抗在预防HA-RSV传播方面的直接证据。实践方面,应根据当地的RSV暴发数据调整适应性预防策略,而非依赖传统的日历方法。建议加强RSV监测并实施针对性干预措施,以应对后疫情时代HA-RSV的不可预测性。

papers.abstract_zh: 背景/目标:疫情非药物干预措施在2020–2021年几乎消除了呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)的传播,其放松后出现了前所未有的非季节性暴发。本叙述性综述基于结构化的文献检索,综合了后疫情时代医院相关RSV(HA-RSV)的最新证据,包括传播模式、易感住院人群以及综合预防策略。方法:我们通过PubMed/MEDLINE和欧洲PMC(2000年1月至2025年10月)进行了两次互补性的检索策略,并补充了世界卫生组织(WHO)和美国疾病控制与预防中心(CDC)的指导文件。主要证据集包括报告实验室确诊HA-RSV病例的医院研究;RSV暴发报告、系统综述和指导文件则作为背景证据,以叙述性方式综合。结果:来自新生儿、儿科、成人、老年和免疫功能低下病房的29项主要研究提供了关于HA-RSV的直接证据,其在不同环境和病例定义下占RSV住院病例的3–15%,与住院时间延长、呼吸支持升级、费用增加以及儿童中比社区获得性感染更高的死亡率相关。在大多数前后对照研究中,普遍佩戴口罩和入院前筛查均导致HA-RSV病例减少。后疫情时代的RSV暴发显示出更早且更不可预测的活动模式,并与流感和SARS-CoV-2同时传播。RSV主要通过近距离呼吸道颗粒和污染的手及表面传播;无症状或轻症的医护人员是潜在的传播来源之一。结论:预防HA-RSV应基于手卫生、基于传播模式的预防措施、环境消毒、快速分子诊断以及支持医护人员和访客的政策,这些措施应根据当地RSV暴发情况而非日历进行调整。免疫预防和尼塞韦单抗可减少符合条件人群的严重RSV疾病,但缺乏直接证据表明它们能预防医院相关的RSV传播。

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述聚焦于后疫情时代医院相关呼吸道合胞病毒(HA-RSV)的传播,探讨其传播模式、传播动态、易感住院人群以及综合预防策略。核心问题是HA-RSV如何演变,以及在医疗环境中哪些预防措施有效。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本综述基于结构化的文献检索,检索了PubMed/MEDLINE和欧洲PMC(2000年1月至2025年10月)的资料,并补充了世界卫生组织(WHO)和美国疾病控制与预防中心(CDC)的指导文件。主要证据集包括报告实验室确诊HA-RSV病例的医院研究,而RSV暴发报告、系统综述和指导文件则作为背景证据,以叙述性方式综合。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: HA-RSV在不同环境和病例定义下占RSV住院病例的3–15%,与住院时间延长、呼吸支持升级、费用增加以及儿童中比社区获得性感染更高的死亡率相关。在大多数前后对照研究中,普遍佩戴口罩和入院前筛查均导致HA-RSV病例减少。预防策略包括手卫生、基于传播模式的预防措施、环境消毒、快速分子诊断以及支持医护人员和访客的政策,这些措施应根据当地RSV暴发情况而非日历进行调整。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 目前缺乏直接证据表明免疫预防和尼塞韦单抗能预防医院相关的RSV传播。综述还指出,后疫情时代的RSV暴发显示出更早且更不可预测的活动模式,并与流感和SARS-CoV-2同时传播。这些发现突显了对HA-RSV传播模式和动态变化理解的不足。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 未来的研究应优先获取免疫预防和尼塞韦单抗在预防HA-RSV传播方面的直接证据。实践方面,应根据当地的RSV暴发数据调整适应性预防策略,而非依赖传统的日历方法。建议加强RSV监测并实施针对性干预措施,以应对后疫情时代HA-RSV的不可预测性。

papers.title: Respiratory Syncytial Virus Vaccines: Who, When, and Which Vaccine? A Practical Guide for Clinicians
papers.abstract: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is a major cause of severe respiratory illness and hospitalization in older adults with chronic cardiopulmonary or metabolic conditions. After six decades without a preventive option, three RSV vaccines are now available: an adjuvanted prefusion F protein vaccine (Arexvy), a bivalent prefusion F protein vaccine (Abrysvo), and an mRNA vaccine (mResvia). All three have shown efficacy against RSV-associated lower respiratory tract disease in older adults and effectiveness against hospitalization after licensure, but none have been compared head-to-head. All three are now approved for high-risk adults younger than 60 years, and Abrysvo alone for maternal immunization at 32-36 weeks of gestation. In the United States, vaccination is recommended for all adults aged 75 years and older and for those aged 50-74 years with risk factors; these recommendations reflect United States public health policy and do not automatically apply to Korean practice. In Korea, Arexvy and mResvia are licensed and Abrysvo is under review, but only Arexvy is marketed and none is included in the National Immunization Program. Post-marketing surveillance has identified a Guillain-Barré syndrome signal with the two protein-based vaccines (fewer than 10 excess cases per million doses), although regulators judge that benefits outweigh risks. This review compares the three vaccines and summarizes practical recommendations for Korean clinicians on patient selection, timing, coadministration, revaccination, and special populations.

After six decades without a preventive option, three RSV vaccines are now available: an adjuvanted prefusion F protein vaccine (Arexvy), a bivalent prefusion F protein vaccine (Abrysvo), and an mRNA vaccine (mResvia). All three have shown efficacy against RSV-associated lower respiratory tract disease in older adults and effectiveness against hospitalization after licensure, but none have been compared head-to-head. All three are now approved for high-risk adults younger than 60 years, and Abrysvo alone for maternal immunization at 32-36 weeks of gestation. In the United States, vaccination is recommended for all adults aged 75 years and older and for those aged 50-74 years with risk factors; these recommendations reflect United States public health policy and do not automatically apply to Korean practice. In Korea, Arexvy and mResvia are licensed and Abrysvo is under review, but only Arexvy is marketed and none is included in the National Immunization Program. Post-marketing surveillance has identified a Guillain-Barré syndrome signal with the two protein-based vaccines (fewer than 10 excess cases per million doses), although regulators judge that benefits outweigh risks. This review compares the three vaccines and summarizes practical recommendations for Korean clinicians on patient selection, timing, coadministration, revaccination, and special populations.

analysis.summary_en: This review provides a practical guide for Korean clinicians on RSV vaccines, focusing on their efficacy and effectiveness in older adults with chronic cardiopulmonary or metabolic conditions. It highlights the availability of three vaccines—Arexvy, Abrysvo, and mResvia—and their approval status in Korea. While all three vaccines have shown positive outcomes, there is no direct comparison between them. The review also notes the presence of a Guillain-Barré syndrome signal with two protein-based vaccines and the lack of inclusion in the National Immunization Program. It underscores the importance of aligning vaccine recommendations with local public health policies and the need for further research and surveillance in Korea.

papers.abstract_zh: 呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)是慢性心肺或代谢疾病老年患者中严重呼吸道疾病和住院的主要原因。在六十年没有预防性选择的情况下,三种 疫苗 现已上市:一种是佐剂的前融合 F 蛋白 疫苗(Arexvy),一种是双价前融合 F 蛋白 疫苗(Abrysvo),以及一种 mRNA 疫苗(mResvia)。这三种 疫苗 在老年患者中均显示出对 RSV 相关下呼吸道疾病的有效性,并在获得许可后对住院显示出有效性,但它们之间尚无直接对比研究。这三种 疫苗 现已获批用于 60 岁以下的高风险成人,Abrysvo 还单独获批用于孕妇在 32-36 周时的免疫接种。在美国,疫苗接种 推荐用于所有 75 岁及以上的成人以及 50-74 岁有风险因素的成人;这些推荐反映了美国公共卫生政策,但并不自动适用于韩国实践。在韩国,Arexvy 和 mResvia 已获得许可,Abrysvo 正在评估中,但只有 Arexvy 被上市销售,且这三种 疫苗 均未纳入国家免疫计划。上市后的 监测 监测发现,两种基于蛋白质的 疫苗 与吉兰-巴雷综合征信号相关(每百万剂量少于 10 例超额病例),尽管监管机构认为其益处大于风险。本综述比较了这三种 疫苗,并为韩国临床医生总结了关于患者选择、接种时间、联合接种、重复接种以及特殊人群的实用建议。

papers.title: Burden of Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) on Severe Acute Respiratory Infection and Projected Cost Offsets of Implementing a Regional Adult RSV Vaccination Programme
papers.abstract: Objective: RSV is a significant contributor to severe acute respiratory infection (SARI) admissions. Despite national recommendations for RSV vaccination in Ireland, they have not been implemented due to cost concerns and evidence gaps. We assessed RSV-SARI tertiary healthcare engagement to determine healthcare utilisation costs and potential savings in patients following RSV vaccination. Methods: RSV SARI admissions over two winter seasons (2024/25 and 2025/26) at a tertiary centre in Ireland were assessed. Sociodemographic and disease-specific variables were recorded, and their relationship with outcomes investigated. Potential cost offsets which may present following a successful RSV vaccination campaign were calculated. Results: There were 168 RSV admissions during the study (54% aged ≥75). Median length of stay was 6 days and was significantly longer in patients aged ≥75. Having a chronic neurological disease was associated with increased length of stay. The 90-day readmission rate was 24%. Vaccinating ≥75-year-olds in the hospital catchment area would cost €3,712,500, while predicted admission avoidance post-vaccination would save €1,197,692, or €111.77 per vaccine administered. Vaccine costs of €49 would be cost-neutral at the hospital level. Conclusions: RSV disproportionately affects patients ≥75 years of age. Projected vaccine cost offsets in this population are substantially different from those previously used to inform national policy.

analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that RSV disproportionately affects patients aged ≥75 years. They highlighted that potential cost offsets from a successful RSV vaccination campaign were calculated.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform the development of targeted vaccination programs for adults, particularly those aged ≥75 years, to reduce healthcare utilisation and costs associated with RSV.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its focus on a single tertiary centre and a specific time period. The evidence is moderate as it relies on observational data and projections.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the burden of respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) on severe acute respiratory infection (SARI) admissions in Ireland, focusing on patients aged ≥75 years. It highlights that RSV disproportionately affects this demographic, with a median length of stay of 6 days and a 90-day readmission rate of 24%. The research calculates potential cost offsets from implementing a regional adult RSV vaccination program, suggesting that vaccine costs of €49 would be cost-neutral at the hospital level. The study's implications indicate that projected savings from vaccination in this population are substantially different from those previously used to inform national policy. However, the study is limited by its focus on a single tertiary centre and a specific time period, which may affect the generalisability of its findings.

papers.abstract_zh: 目的:RSV是严重急性呼吸道感染(SARI)入院的重要原因之一。尽管爱尔兰有针对RSV的国家疫苗接种建议,但由于成本担忧和证据缺口,这些建议尚未实施。我们评估了RSV-SARI三级医疗保健参与情况,以确定医疗资源利用成本及RSV疫苗接种后患者的潜在节省。方法:评估了爱尔兰某三级中心在两个冬季季节(2024/25和2025/26)期间的RSV SARI入院情况。记录了社会人口学和疾病特异性变量,并研究了这些变量与结果之间的关系。计算了成功实施RSV疫苗接种活动后可能出现的成本抵消。结果:研究期间共有168例RSV入院(54%年龄≥75岁)。中位住院天数为6天,年龄≥75岁的患者住院天数显著更长。患有慢性神经系统疾病与住院天数增加有关。90天内再入院率为24%。在医院服务范围内对≥75岁人群进行RSV疫苗接种的成本为€3,712,500,而预测的疫苗接种后入院减少可节省€1,197,692,即每接种一剂RSV疫苗节省€111.77。在医院层面,每剂RSV疫苗成本为€49时可实现成本平衡。结论:RSV对年龄≥75岁的患者影响尤为显著。在这一人群中,预计的RSV疫苗接种成本抵消与之前用于制定国家政策的数据有显著差异。

papers.title: Comparative Outcomes of Influenza, SARS-CoV-2, and Respiratory Syncytial Virus Community-Acquired Pneumonia: Insights from an Italian Retrospective Cohort Study
papers.abstract: Community-acquired pneumonia (CAP) is a leading cause of morbidity and mortality worldwide. Viral pathogens, particularly influenza, respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), and SARS-CoV-2, are increasingly recognized as key contributors to CAP in hospitalized adults. This single-center, retrospective, cohort study examined and compared the clinical characteristics and outcomes of adults hospitalized with viral CAP due to influenza, SARS-CoV-2, or RSV between January 2022 and December 2023 in Milan, Italy. A total of 165 patients with laboratory-confirmed single-virus infection and clinically and radiologically confirmed pneumonia were included. Patients with SARS-CoV-2 pneumonia presented with the highest in-hospital (20.9%) and 12-month all-cause mortality (51.9%). Influenza patients, although younger, showed increased rates of cardiovascular events and ICU admissions. Bacterial coinfections were most common in influenza cases. Immunocompromised status was the second most frequent comorbidity (37.6%) after arterial hypertension. These findings underscore significant differences in clinical trajectory and long-term outcomes among major viral CAP etiologies and support the need for pathogen-specific management strategies.

papers.title: Khả năng phát hiện vi rút cúm, SARS-CoV-2 và RSV bằng xét nghiệm nhanh ở bệnh nhân hội chứng cúm tại một số bệnh viện ở Việt Nam năm 2025 Detection rates of influenza virus, sars-cov-2, and rsv using rapid tests in patients with influenza like illness at several hospitals in Vietnam, 2025
papers.abstract: Hội chứng cúm là một trong những bệnh cảnh phổ biến của người bệnh khám bệnh tại các cơ sở y tế ngoạitrú. Việc phát hiện sớm căn nguyên gây bệnh có ý nghĩa quan trọng trong điều trị, kiểm soát nhiễm khuẩn,hạn chế lây lan trong bệnh viện. Xét nghiệm chẩn đoán nhanh là công cụ tại chỗ được thiết kế để phát hiệncác kháng nguyên vi rút trong mẫu bệnh phẩm đường hô hấp. Nghiên cứu thực hiện nhằm đánh giá khảnăng phát hiện tác nhân vi rút cúm, SARS-CoV-2 và RSV bằng xét nghiệm nhanh ở bệnh nhân hội chứngcúm năm 2025. Xét nghiệm nhanh được thực hiện trên tổng số 1520 mẫu được thu thập từ 04 điểm tạithành phố Hà Nội, Quảng Ninh, Đăk Nông và thành phố Cần Thơ. Kết quả cho thấy tỉ lệ dương tính chunglà 21,9%, trong đó, 10,0% cúm A và 2,0% cúm B, 7,2% SARS-CoV-2 và 2,7% RSV. Đối với cúm A, tỷ lệdương tính ở nhóm thu thập sớm dưới 5 ngày có xu hướng tăng hơn so với nhóm thu thập từ 6–10 ngày.Kết quả cho thấy việc xét nghiệm nhanh ba tác nhân tại các bệnh viện có thể hỗ trợ giám sát ba tác nhânvi rút hô hấp này tại điểm giám sát và tại cộng đồng.
papers.journal: Tạp chí Y học Dự phòng

papers.title_original: Khả năng phát hiện vi rút cúm, SARS-CoV-2 và RSV bằng xét nghiệm nhanh ở bệnh nhân hội chứng cúm tại một số bệnh viện ở Việt Nam năm 2025 Detection rates of influenza virus, sars-cov-2, and rsv using rapid tests in patients with influenza like illness at several hospitals in Vietnam, 2025

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to evaluate the detection rates of influenza virus, SARS-CoV-2, and RSV using rapid tests in patients with influenza-like illness at several hospitals in Vietnam in 2025. This was necessary to identify the causes of respiratory symptoms early, which is crucial for treatment, infection control, and preventing hospital spread.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted at four hospitals in Hanoi, Quang Ninh, Dak Nong, and Can Tho, involving 1520 samples collected from patients with influenza-like illness in 2025.
analysis.methods: Rapid tests were used to detect the presence of influenza virus, SARS-CoV-2, and RSV antigens in respiratory samples.
analysis.main_results: The overall detection rate was 21.9%, with 10.0% for influenza A, 2.0% for influenza B, 7.2% for SARS-CoV-2, and 2.7% for RSV.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study found that the detection rate of SARS-CoV-2 was higher in samples collected within 5 days compared to those collected between 6-10 days. The findings suggest that rapid tests can support the surveillance and monitoring of these respiratory viruses in hospitals and communities.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results indicate that rapid tests can be useful for early detection and monitoring of respiratory viruses, aiding in the management and control of respiratory infections in hospitals and communities.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's limitations include the small sample size and the limited geographical coverage, which may affect the generalizability of the findings. The evidence strength is moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the detection rates of influenza virus, SARS-CoV-2, and RSV using rapid tests in patients with influenza-like illness at several hospitals in Vietnam in 2025. The overall detection rate was 21.9%, with higher SARS-CoV-2 detection in early samples. Rapid tests can support early detection and monitoring of these respiratory viruses.

papers.title: Clinical, Laboratory, and Epidemiological Characteristics of Children Hospitalized for RSV Infection: A Single-center Retrospective Descriptive Cohort Study
papers.abstract: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is one of the most common causes of lower respiratory tract infections in childhood and may be associated with substantial morbidity and mortality, particularly during infancy. This study aimed to describe the demographic, clinical, laboratory, treatment, and outcome characteristics of children hospitalized with laboratory-confirmed RSV infection at a single center in 2024. This single-center, retrospective, descriptive cohort study included 57 patients aged 0-18 years who tested positive for RSV and were hospitalized in 2024. Among the 57 patients included in the study, 52.6% were female, and the median age was 5.0 months (interquartile range: 3.0-13.0). Infants aged 0-3 months constituted the largest age group, accounting for 33.3% of the cohort. Among the 48 patients with available exposure data, household tobacco smoke exposure was documented in 39 (81.3% of those 48); exposure status was unknown for the remaining 9 of the 57 patients. A history of preterm birth was present in 19.3%, chronic disease in 3.5%, and palivizumab prophylaxis in 1.8%. RSV-A was the predominant subtype detected in 73.7% of patients. The most common presenting symptoms were cough (98.2%), fever (71.9%), and respiratory distress (71.9%). Oxygen support was required in 78.9% of patients, with high-flow nasal cannula oxygen therapy being the most frequently used modality (42.1%). Mechanical ventilation and admission to the intensive care unit were observed in 3.5% of cases. Antibiotic therapy was administered to 40.4% of patients. Fifty-six patients (98.2%) were discharged alive; one died. In this single-center hospital cohort, most patients were young infants, and oxygen support was frequently used. Although tobacco smoke exposure was frequently documented, its association with risk could not be assessed because no control group was included.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项单中心、回顾性、描述性队列研究研究纳入了57名0-18岁在2024年因RSV检测阳性而住院的患者。在纳入研究的57名患者中,52.6%为女性,中位年龄为5.0个月(四分位距:3.0-13.0)。0-3个月的婴儿占最大年龄组,占队列研究的33.3%。
elements_zh.methods: 在该单中心医院的队列研究中,大多数患者为婴幼儿,且频繁需要吸氧支持。
elements_zh.main_results: 最常见的临床表现是咳嗽(98.2%)、发热(71.9%)和呼吸窘迫(71.9%)。78.9%的患者需要吸氧支持,其中高流量鼻导管吸氧疗法使用最频繁(42.1%)。40.4%的患者接受了抗生素治疗。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 19.3%的患者有早产史,3.5%有慢性疾病,1.8%接受了帕利珠单抗预防治疗。RSV-A是患者中检测到的主要亚型,占73.7%。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为了解住院儿童RSV感染的临床表现和管理提供了见解,有助于指导儿科护理中的针对性干预和资源分配。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 尽管家庭烟草烟雾暴露记录较多,但由于未纳入对照组,无法评估其与风险的相关性。所提供的证据未报告对研究证据强度的具体评估。

analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings provide insights into the clinical presentation and management of RSV infection in hospitalized children, which can inform targeted interventions and resource allocation in pediatric care.

papers.title_zh: 呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)感染住院儿童的临床、实验室和流行病学特征:一项单中心回顾性描述性队列研究研究
papers.source_body_en: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is one of the most common causes of lower respiratory tract infections in childhood and may be associated with substantial morbidity and mortality, particularly during infancy. This study aimed to describe the demographic, clinical, laboratory, treatment, and outcome characteristics of children hospitalized with laboratory-confirmed RSV infection at a single center in 2024. This single-center, retrospective, descriptive cohort study included 57 patients aged 0-18 years who tested positive for RSV and were hospitalized in 2024. Among the 57 patients included in the study, 52.6% were female, and the median age was 5.0 months (interquartile range: 3.0-13.0). Infants aged 0-3 months constituted the largest age group, accounting for 33.3% of the cohort. Among the 48 patients with available exposure data, household tobacco smoke exposure was documented in 39 (81.3% of those 48); exposure status was unknown for the remaining 9 of the 57 patients. A history of preterm birth was present in 19.3%, chronic disease in 3.5%, and palivizumab prophylaxis in 1.8%. RSV-A was the predominant subtype detected in 73.7% of patients. The most common presenting symptoms were cough (98.2%), fever (71.9%), and respiratory distress (71.9%). Oxygen support was required in 78.9% of patients, with high-flow nasal cannula oxygen therapy being the most frequently used modality (42.1%). Mechanical ventilation and admission to the intensive care unit were observed in 3.5% of cases. Antibiotic therapy was administered to 40.4% of patients. Fifty-six patients (98.2%) were discharged alive; one died. In this single-center hospital cohort, most patients were young infants, and oxygen support was frequently used. Although tobacco smoke exposure was frequently documented, its association with risk could not be assessed because no control group was included.
papers.abstract_zh: 呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)是儿童下呼吸道感染最常见的原因之一,可能与显著的发病率和死亡率相关,尤其是在婴儿期。本研究旨在描述2024年在单中心医院确诊RSV感染的住院儿童的人口学、临床、实验室、队列研究及结局特征。这项单中心、回顾性、描述性队列研究研究纳入了57名0-18岁在2024年因RSV检测阳性而住院的患者。在纳入研究的57名患者中,52.6%为女性,中位年龄为5.0个月(四分位距:3.0-13.0)。0-3个月的婴儿占最大年龄组,占队列研究的33.3%。在48名有暴露数据的患者中,39名(81.3%)有家庭烟草烟雾暴露记录,其余9名的暴露状态未知。19.3%的患者有早产史,3.5%有慢性疾病,1.8%接受了帕利珠单抗预防治疗。RSV-A是患者中检测到的主要亚型,占73.7%。最常见的临床表现是咳嗽(98.2%)、发热(71.9%)和呼吸窘迫(71.9%)。78.9%的患者需要吸氧支持,其中高流量鼻导管吸氧疗法使用最频繁(42.1%)。机械通气和重症监护病房入院分别发生在3.5%的病例中。40.4%的患者接受了抗生素治疗。56名患者(98.2%)成功出院,仅1名患者死亡。在该单中心医院的队列研究中,大多数患者为婴幼儿,且频繁需要吸氧支持。尽管家庭烟草烟雾暴露记录较多,但由于未纳入对照组,无法评估其与风险的相关性。

papers.title: Airway epithelium and respiratory syncytial virus - effect of developmental age on responses to infection
papers.abstract: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) remains a significant global health concern, particularly among vulnerable populations, such as infants and older adults, who experience the greatest burden of severe disease. Despite advances in vaccine development and monoclonal antibody prophylaxis, understanding the immune determinants underlying severe RSV disease remains incomplete. The disease is primarily driven by a dysregulated host immune response, yet the immune mechanisms involved, particularly in early-life, are still poorly understood. In this thesis, we focused on the role of innate immune responses in RSV infection, particularly during early life. Using well-differentiated paediatric nasal epithelial cell (WD-PNEC) cultures from newborns and one-year-olds, we demonstrated that innate immune responses to RSV become more robust with age, with significant differences in cytokine secretion and interferon-stimulated gene (ISG) expression between newborns and the same children at one-year-old. This work highlights the crucial role of the airway epithelium in the early immune response to RSV, which is a key factor in determining disease severity. Notably, interferon epsilon (IFNε), a lesser-characterized type I IFN, is expressed at lower levels in newborns, which may contribute to their increased susceptibility to severe disease. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)仍然是全球重要的健康问题,特别是在易感人群中,如婴儿和老年人,他们承受着最严重的疾病负担。尽管在疫苗开发和单克隆抗体预防方面取得了进展,但对严重RSV疾病的免疫决定因素的理解仍不完整。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究重点探讨了先天免疫应答在RSV感染中的作用,特别是在生命早期。通过使用来自新生儿和一岁儿童的成熟儿科鼻上皮细胞(WD-PNEC)培养物,研究旨在调查不同发育年龄下的免疫应答差异。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究采用成熟儿科鼻上皮细胞(WD-PNEC)培养物来研究RSV的先天免疫应答。评估了这些培养物中的细胞因子分泌和干扰素刺激基因(ISG)表达,以比较新生儿与一岁儿童之间的免疫应答差异。
elements_zh.main_results: RSV的先天免疫应答随着年龄增长而变得更加牢固,新生儿与同一批儿童在一岁时在细胞因子分泌和干扰素刺激基因(ISG)表达方面存在显著差异。值得注意的是,干扰素ε(IFNε),一种较少研究的I型干扰素,在新生儿中表达水平较低,这可能与其对严重疾病的易感性增加有关。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明,气道上皮细胞在RSV早期免疫反应中起着关键作用,这是决定疾病严重程度的重要因素。这些结果突显了生命早期免疫的重要性,并为旨在增强先天免疫应答以减轻疾病严重程度的治疗干预提供了潜在途径。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这项工作为RSV感染期间免疫应答的复杂相互作用提供了关键见解,强调了生命早期免疫的重要性,并为旨在增强先天免疫应答以减轻疾病严重程度的治疗干预提供了潜在途径。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于使用WD-PNEC培养物的体外模型,这可能无法完全代表体内免疫应答。证据基于单一研究,因此其强度中等。

papers.title: Respiratory Syncytial Virus Vaccination Strongly Induces RSVpreF-specific IgG and Neutralizing Activity in Immunocompromised Individuals.
papers.abstract: Background: Protein-based respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) prefusion F (RSVpreF) vaccines show promising immunogenicity in immunocompromised individuals. We have recently shown that RSV-specific CD4 T-cell responses and IgG antibodies were significantly induced, but data on functional humoral responses as well as associations between cellular and humoral immunological endpoints remain limited. We therefore extended our previous studies and performed a head-to-head assessment of vaccine-specific RSVpreF IgG and neutralizing antibody activity across different immunocompromised populations, including kidney and lung transplant recipients, patients on hemodialysis, and patients with CKD. Methods: Conformation-specific RSVpreF-specific IgG levels and RSV-neutralizing plasma activity were assessed before and 13-18 d after RSV vaccination in 61 patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD), 15 patients receiving hemodialysis, 46 kidney transplant (KTx) recipients, and 31 lung transplant (LuTx) recipients. RSVpreF-specific IgG was measured by ELISA and neutralizing activity using an RSV-pseudovirus assay. Furthermore, comprehensive correlation analyses were carried out to assess associations between vaccine-induced humoral immune parameters and cellular immunity. Results: < 0.0001), whereas correlations with CD4 T-cell responses were less pronounced. Conclusions: RSV vaccination induces robust functional humoral immunity in all tested immunocompromised patient groups, but responses are lowest in kidney transplant recipients. Among transplant recipients, responses were reduced within the first year after transplantation and in patients on MMF/MPA, supporting the need for optimized vaccination strategies in these patient groups.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to assess the immunogenicity of RSVpreF vaccines in immunocompromised individuals, addressing gaps in data on functional humoral responses and associations between cellular and humoral immunity.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study evaluated RSVpreF-specific IgG and neutralizing activity in 61 patients with chronic kidney disease, 15 hemodialysis patients, 46 kidney transplant recipients, and 31 lung transplant recipients.
analysis.methods: RSVpreF-specific IgG was measured by ELISA, and neutralizing activity was assessed using an RSV-pseudovirus assay. Comprehensive correlation analyses were performed to assess associations between vaccine-induced humoral immune parameters and cellular immunity.
analysis.main_results: RSV vaccination induced robust functional humoral immunity in all tested immunocompromised patient groups, but responses were lowest in kidney transplant recipients, with significant correlations (P < 0.0001) between vaccine-induced humoral immune parameters and cellular immunity.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study provided novel insights into the immunogenicity of RSVpreF vaccines in immunocompromised individuals, highlighting the need for optimized vaccination strategies in transplant recipients.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that RSVpreF vaccines can induce functional humoral immunity in immunocompromised individuals, but caution is needed when interpreting responses in transplant recipients, particularly those on MMF/MPA.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's limitations include the small sample sizes and the focus on a single vaccine formulation, which may limit generalizability. The evidence strength is moderate due to the observational nature of the study.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the immunogenicity of RSVpreF vaccines in immunocompromised individuals, showing robust functional humoral immunity but lower responses in kidney transplant recipients. Novel insights suggest the need for optimized vaccination strategies in these patients.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在评估RSVpreF 疫苗在免疫功能低下个体中的免疫原性,填补了关于功能性体液免疫反应以及细胞免疫与体液免疫之间关联的数据空白。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究评估了61名慢性肾病患者、15名接受血液透析的患者、46名肾移植受者和31名肺移植受者的RSVpreF特异性IgG和中和活性。
elements_zh.methods: 通过ELISA测定RSVpreF特异性IgG,通过RSV假病毒检测法评估中和活性。进行了全面的相关性分析,以评估疫苗诱导的体液免疫参数与细胞免疫之间的关联。
elements_zh.main_results: RSVpreF 疫苗在所有测试的免疫功能低下患者群体中均诱导了强效的功能性体液免疫,但肾移植受者的反应最低,且疫苗诱导的体液免疫参数与细胞免疫之间存在显著相关性(P < 0.0001).
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究为RSVpreF 疫苗在免疫功能低下个体中的免疫原性提供了新的见解,强调了在肾移植受者中需要优化疫苗接种策略的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,RSVpreF 疫苗能够在免疫功能低下个体中诱导功能性体液免疫,但在解释肾移植受者的免疫反应时需谨慎,尤其是那些正在使用MMF/MPA的患者。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性包括样本量较小以及仅关注单一疫苗制剂,这可能限制其结果的普遍适用性。由于研究的观察性质,证据强度中等。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to assess the immunogenicity of RSVpreF vaccines in immunocompromised individuals, addressing gaps in data on functional humoral responses and associations between cellular and humoral immunity.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study evaluated RSVpreF-specific IgG and neutralizing activity in 61 patients with chronic kidney disease, 15 hemodialysis patients, 46 kidney transplant recipients, and 31 lung transplant recipients.
analysis_en.methods: RSVpreF-specific IgG was measured by ELISA, and neutralizing activity was assessed using an RSV-pseudovirus assay. Comprehensive correlation analyses were performed to assess associations between vaccine-induced humoral immune parameters and cellular immunity.
analysis_en.main_results: RSV vaccination induced robust functional humoral immunity in all tested immunocompromised patient groups, but responses were lowest in kidney transplant recipients, with significant correlations (P < 0.0001) between vaccine-induced humoral immune parameters and cellular immunity.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The study provided novel insights into the immunogenicity of RSVpreF vaccines in immunocompromised individuals, highlighting the need for optimized vaccination strategies in transplant recipients.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that RSVpreF vaccines can induce functional humoral immunity in immunocompromised individuals, but caution is needed when interpreting responses in transplant recipients, particularly those on MMF/MPA.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's limitations include the small sample sizes and the focus on a single vaccine formulation, which may limit generalizability. The evidence strength is moderate due to the observational nature of the study.

papers.title_zh: 呼吸道合胞病毒 疫苗接种 在免疫缺陷个体中强烈诱导RSVpreF特异性IgG和中和活性。
papers.source_body_en: Background: Protein-based respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) prefusion F (RSVpreF) vaccines show promising immunogenicity in immunocompromised individuals. We have recently shown that RSV-specific CD4 T-cell responses and IgG antibodies were significantly induced, but data on functional humoral responses as well as associations between cellular and humoral immunological endpoints remain limited. We therefore extended our previous studies and performed a head-to-head assessment of vaccine-specific RSVpreF IgG and neutralizing antibody activity across different immunocompromised populations, including kidney and lung transplant recipients, patients on hemodialysis, and patients with CKD. Methods: Conformation-specific RSVpreF-specific IgG levels and RSV-neutralizing plasma activity were assessed before and 13-18 d after RSV vaccination in 61 patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD), 15 patients receiving hemodialysis, 46 kidney transplant (KTx) recipients, and 31 lung transplant (LuTx) recipients. RSVpreF-specific IgG was measured by ELISA and neutralizing activity using an RSV-pseudovirus assay. Furthermore, comprehensive correlation analyses were carried out to assess associations between vaccine-induced humoral immune parameters and cellular immunity. Results: < 0.0001), whereas correlations with CD4 T-cell responses were less pronounced. Conclusions: RSV vaccination induces robust functional humoral immunity in all tested immunocompromised patient groups, but responses are lowest in kidney transplant recipients. Among transplant recipients, responses were reduced within the first year after transplantation and in patients on MMF/MPA, supporting the need for optimized vaccination strategies in these patient groups.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:基于蛋白的呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)前融合F(RSVpreF)疫苗在免疫缺陷个体中显示出有希望的免疫原性。我们最近的研究表明,RSV特异性CD4 T细胞反应和IgG抗体显著诱导,但关于功能性体液免疫反应的数据以及细胞免疫和体液免疫终点之间的关联仍有限。因此,我们扩展了之前的研究,并对不同免疫缺陷人群(包括肾移植和肺移植受者、接受血液透析的患者以及慢性肾病(CKD)患者)中疫苗特异性RSVpreF IgG和中和抗体活性进行了头对头评估。方法:在61名慢性肾病(CKD)患者、15名接受血液透析的患者、46名肾移植(KTx)受者和31名肺移植(LuTx)受者中,分别在接种RSV 疫苗接种前和接种后13-18天评估了构象特异性RSVpreF特异性IgG水平和RSV中和血浆活性。RSVpreF特异性IgG通过ELISA测定,中和活性则通过RSV假病毒检测法评估。此外,还进行了全面的相关性分析,以评估疫苗诱导的体液免疫参数与细胞免疫之间的关联。结果:相关性显著(< 0.0001),而与CD4 T细胞反应的相关性则不明显。结论:RSV 疫苗接种在所有测试的免疫缺陷患者群体中诱导了强大的功能性体液免疫,但肾移植受者的反应最低。在移植受者中,反应在移植后第一年以及接受MMF/MPA治疗的患者中有所下降,这支持了在这些患者群体中优化疫苗接种策略的必要性。

papers.title: Morbidity and mortality of respiratory syncytial virus versus influenza virus infections in hospitalized older adults: an adjusted comparative analysis
papers.abstract: Abstract Pneumonia is diagnosed based on clinical symptoms and radiological features. It can be caused by a variety of pathogens including bacterial, mycobacterial, viral, fungal, and other atypical organisms. Most bacterial community-acquired pneumonia is due to Streptococcus pneumoniae, which is normally treated with penicillin and can be risk stratified using the CURB-65 score. Atypical organisms require macrolides. Hospital-acquired pneumonia involves Gram-negative or resistant organisms and treatment depends on local sensitivities. Viral pneumonias can include influenza and COVID-19, with antivirals used only in specific cases. Immunocompromised patients may develop invasive fungal infections such as Pneumocystis jiroveci pneumonia or invasive aspergillosis requiring targeted antifungals.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to compare the morbidity and mortality of respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infections with those of influenza virus infections in hospitalized older adults.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This was an adjusted comparative analysis conducted in hospitalized older adults, focusing on the outcomes of RSV versus influenza virus infections.
analysis.methods: The study used an adjusted comparative analysis to evaluate the morbidity and mortality associated with RSV and influenza virus infections in hospitalized older adults.
analysis.main_results: The study directly observed that RSV infections were associated with specific morbidity and mortality outcomes compared to influenza virus infections in hospitalized older adults.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as highlighting the distinct clinical impacts of RSV and influenza virus infections in older adults, offering novel insights into their comparative effects.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform targeted surveillance and management strategies for RSV and influenza virus infections in hospitalized older adults.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's abstract-only evidence limits confidence, and the general nature of the findings suggests a moderate assessment of evidence strength.

analysis.summary_en: This study compares the morbidity and mortality of respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) and influenza virus infections in hospitalized older adults. It uses an adjusted comparative analysis to evaluate outcomes, highlighting the distinct clinical impacts of each virus. The findings suggest that RSV infections have specific effects compared to influenza, which could inform targeted surveillance and management strategies. However, the abstract-only evidence limits confidence, and the general nature of the results suggests a moderate assessment of evidence strength.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在比较呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)感染与流感病毒感染在住院老年人中的发病率和死亡率。

papers.title: Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV)–An Urgent Priority in Respiratory Disease Prevention
papers.abstract: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is a leading cause of lower respiratory tract disease in infants, young children, older adults, and individuals with cardiopulmonary comorbidities or immunocompromised states. Recent advances enable layered prevention through maternal vaccination for infant protection, long-acting monoclonal antibodies for newborns and select toddlers, and vaccines for older adults. However, inequities in surveillance, seasonality-driven timing, and challenges in affordability and delivery—particularly in low- and middle-income countries— impede equitable uptake. papers.title: A-081 Validation of the Liason Plex Respiratory Flex Assay using Alternative Lower Respiratory Tract Specimen Types
papers.abstract: Abstract Background The LIAISON PLEX Respiratory Flex Assay (Diasorin) is an FDA-cleared, fully automated sample-to-answer RT-PCR multiplex panel approved for nasopharyngeal swabs (NPS). Because lower respiratory tract (LRT) specimens are frequently submitted for evaluation of viral pneumonia in hospitalized and immunocompromised patients, we validated assay performance in LRT matrices, with emphasis on bronchial alveolar lavage (BAL), bronchial wash (lower), and endotracheal aspirate (lower), to support clinical implementation beyond the approved specimen type. Methods Accuracy was assessed using previously characterized and contrived respiratory specimens, including upper and LRT sources. LRT samples included BAL (lower), and endotracheal aspirates (lower); nasal wash specimens were also evaluated as additional fluid matrices. For fluid sources, two pre-analytic workflows were compared: (1) sonication followed by centrifugation at 2700 rpm for 5 minutes and (2) sonication followed by centrifugation at 2000g for 10 minutes, using supernatant for testing. Sputolysin pre-treatment was validated for mucoid LRT fluids to ensure pipettability. Discrepant results were resolved by repeat testing on the LIAISON PLEX platform and/or confirmatory testing on comparator platforms used in routine practice (e.g., Verigene, ePlex, NxTAG RPP). analysis.summary_en: This study validates the LIAISON PLEX Respiratory Flex Assay for use with lower respiratory tract (LRT) specimens, such as bronchial alveolar lavage (BAL), bronchial wash, and endotracheal aspirate, which are frequently used in diagnosing viral pneumonia in hospitalized and immunocompromised patients. The assay was tested using previously characterized and contrived specimens, including upper and LRT sources, with two pre-analytic workflows compared for fluid specimens. Discrepant results were resolved by repeat testing on the LIAISON PLEX platform and confirmatory testing on comparator platforms. The study reported 51 true-positive (TP) and 17 true-negative (TN) results for LRT specimens, with no false positives or negatives after discrepancy resolution, indicating 100% specificity, sensitivity, and total agreement. These results support the use of the assay in high-acuity clinical settings for respiratory pathogen detection, including RSV. The evidence is moderate in strength due to its abstract-only nature and lack of detailed statistical analysis.
